name: Ticket booth
adds: Visitors buy their tickets here; stand behind the counter to sell them

name: Carousel
adds: The first ride: visitors climb on, and it goes round when every horse is taken or when you pull its lever

name: Candy floss cart
adds: Sweets for the visitors (+10% visitors); stand behind the cart to serve

name: Benches
adds: Somewhere to sit: visitors wait 30% longer in line

name: Bumper cars
adds: The Midway's first ride: six cars to drive and bump, launched from its lever

name: Ticket seller
adds: Sells tickets at the booth for you, and candy floss when the booth is quiet

name: Supply shed
adds: The delivery truck drops sugar, buns and prizes here; carry them to the stalls. Every sale pays 10% more

name: Ride operator
adds: Launches the rides in Kiddie Corner and the Midway: when one is full, or when its first rider has waited a while

name: Ring-toss booth
adds: A throw for a plush prize; it needs prizes from the shed

name: Mechanic
adds: Fixes rides that break down, and services worn ones before they do (stand at a lever to do either yourself)

name: Teacups
adds: Kiddie Corner's second ride: four big cups that spin (+15% visitors)

name: Burger stand
adds: Burgers for hungry visitors; it needs buns from the shed

name: Midway vendor
adds: Serves at the ring-toss booth and the burger stand

name: Snack runner
adds: Carries sugar, buns and prizes from the shed to the stalls

name: Park sign and lights
adds: A big lit sign (+30% visitors), and lights all round the park: the evenings begin

name: Janitor and bins
adds: Bins along the paths mean less litter, and the janitor sweeps up the rest

name: Sky swings
adds: Lakeside's first ride: twelve chairs that fly out as it spins

name: Bus stop
adds: Tour buses bring a crowd at a time

name: Paddle boats
adds: Swan boats round the lake, with a dock hand who launches Lakeside's rides: the boats and the sky swings

name: Haunted house
adds: A spooky dark ride that keeps running in any weather

name: Mascot
adds: Starry cheers up the longest line (people wait longer) and poses for photos

name: Cashier
adds: Collects the cash piles for you

name: Log flume
adds: The Thrill Zone's splash ride: logs float round, up the lift and down into the pool (+15% visitors)

name: Gift shop
adds: Souvenirs on the way out, and the prize shelf; it sells the prizes the truck brings

name: Park manager
adds: Runs the whole park: full earnings while you are in another town

name: Fireworks barge
adds: Fireworks over the lake every evening: half as many visitors again at night, and night rides pay 25% more

name: Starlight Comet
adds: The roller coaster, all the way round the park: the biggest ticket of all (+20% visitors)

name: Coaster crew
adds: Launches the Thrill Zone's rides: the Starlight Comet, the log flume and the haunted house

name: Starlight Wheel
adds: The park's landmark, lit like a star at night: sixteen seats in eight open gondolas, and +20% on every ticket, ride and sale

name: Highway to Downtown Bay City
adds: The way to Chapter 4; offered once every town goal is done
